_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. an environment sheet of a weathered shingle shack at a boat launch: exterior with a hand-painted sign reading GULLY'S TACKLE & ROAST, a wooden dock on pilings, crab pots, a chalkboard menu in a crab pot, an old green-webbed lawn chair under the eave, a row of crab flyers on the wall; interior with a counter holding a chrome two-group espresso machine between a bait cooler and an old register, a single stool, a crowded corkboard above the register; labeled GULLY'S. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
